# DuckTinyCC

[![Distribution](https://github.com/sounkou-bioinfo/DuckTinyCC/actions/workflows/MainDistributionPipeline.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sounkou-bioinfo/DuckTinyCC/actions/workflows/MainDistributionPipeline.yml)
[![Fuzzing](https://github.com/sounkou-bioinfo/DuckTinyCC/actions/workflows/native-fuzz.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sounkou-bioinfo/DuckTinyCC/actions/workflows/native-fuzz.yaml)
[![Documentation](https://github.com/sounkou-bioinfo/DuckTinyCC/actions/workflows/pages.yml/badge.svg)](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/DuckTinyCC/)

DuckTinyCC is a DuckDB C extension that embeds TinyCC, compiles trusted C source
at runtime, and registers typed SQL scalar UDFs without writing a shared library.

**[Documentation](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/DuckTinyCC/)** ·
**[SQL reference](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/DuckTinyCC/reference.html)** ·
**[Internals](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/DuckTinyCC/internals.html)** ·
**[Development](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/DuckTinyCC/development.html)**

## Quick start

Build the extension, then start a compatible DuckDB CLI with unsigned extensions
enabled:

```sh
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/sounkou-bioinfo/DuckTinyCC.git
cd DuckTinyCC
make configure release
duckdb -unsigned
```

Compile and register a C function in one SQL call:

```sql
LOAD 'build/release/ducktinycc.duckdb_extension';

SELECT ok, code
FROM tcc_module(
  mode := 'quick_compile',
  source := 'double c_square(double x) { return x * x; }',
  symbol := 'c_square',
  sql_name := 'c_square',
  return_type := 'f64',
  arg_types := ['f64']
);

SELECT c_square(12.0);
```

`quick_compile` parses the signature, generates the DuckDB/C bridge, compiles
and relocates one in-memory TinyCC artifact, and registers the SQL scalar UDF.
The artifact remains alive while the registered function can call it.

## Surface

- `tcc_module(...)` is the control plane for configuration, staged builds,
  compilation, code generation, and C composite helpers.
- `tcc_system_paths(...)` and `tcc_library_probe(...)` diagnose the embedded
  runtime and library search.
- SQL-visible signatures support scalar values and recursive `LIST`, `ARRAY`,
  `STRUCT`, `MAP`, and `UNION` forms.
- Pointer helpers provide managed allocation and bounds-checked reads/writes;
  raw addresses from `tcc_dataptr()` are low-level escape hatches.

Generated functions are scalar UDFs. The three control and diagnostic entry
points above are table functions.

## Runtime boundary

Generated C executes as trusted native code in the DuckDB process. It is not a
sandbox. DuckTinyCC uses `-nostdlib` by default and injects only the host symbols
needed by its bridge and compiler support. Explicitly linked libc functions,
foreign pointers, inline assembly, and syscalls retain their ordinary native
process effects.

See the [internals and ownership reference](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/DuckTinyCC/internals.html)
before retaining pointers or linking process-control APIs.

## Develop

```sh
make debug test_debug
make release test_release
make test_embedded_release
make community_sim
make fuzz-all
```

The full test and sanitizer matrix is documented on the
[development page](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/DuckTinyCC/development.html).
Runnable integration examples remain under [`demo/`](demo/).

## Status

The development version is `0.2.0.9000`. Native runtime compilation is the
supported path. Windows community targets and DuckDB-Wasm runtime execution
remain excluded until their complete compile-and-call paths satisfy the same
release gates as native builds.

DuckDB callback trampolines are not presented as a 1.0 promise: a generic SQL
scalar does not expose a stable `double (*)(double)` invocation ABI. Any future
callback surface requires an explicit binding, context, NULL/error, threading,
and lifetime contract.
